newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES says reinforcing B.ESSI stake.
newsitem.headline: BES says reinforcing B.ESSI stake.

text.p: Portugal's Banco Espirito Santo said that it was reinforcing its position in Banco ESSI in order to be able to consolidate its results but it had no intention of launching a public offer (OPA) for all outstanding stock.
A spokesman said that the bank, which holds 38 percent of ESSI, was raising its stake above 40 percent but that was the extent of its ambitions.
"BES has no intention whatsoever of launching an OPA over Banco ESSI," the spokesman said.
"The intention of BES is to reinforce its position in the bank, above 40 percent, for reasons of consolidation," he said.
On Friday, two percent of the capital of Banco ESSI was traded, equal to 201,512 shares, but the price eased 15 escudos to 2,385 escudos.
The bank's shares rose sharply on Thursday, although in thin volume, on speculation an OPA might be in preparation.
